Invite the QA vendor who will submit the commercial bid.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Move to the vendor-side session required by the case.
Open the live RFQ's pricing sheet in the supplier portal.
Submit the closest expressible equivalent: one vendor quote at price 500.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the quote as submitted.
